title: Come back later: transcript and Claude session resume after a restart
gate: npm run turn:live -- --resume (owner-run: needs the owner's Barkpark login, the enrolled Mac, and a person to restart npm run host). Record: parity/live/resume.json.
evidence: scripts/turn-live.mjs --resume: gives the bot a code made up for the run, the host program is stopped and started, a fresh page shows the conversation again (9 + 9 bubbles), and the bot gives the code back (2026-11-12, restart within 5 s). The transcript is Barkpark's stored rows (asked for from 0, #35); the memory is Claude's own session, which the host resumes by provider_session_id. A restart of the Mac: npm run host:install-agent runs the host program as the LaunchAgent cloud.barkpark.barkbot.chat-host, as barkbot-host.service does on the VM: RunAtLoad, KeepAlive on a failed exit, ThrottleInterval 10, ProcessType Adaptive, logs in ~/Library/Logs/BarkBot, no secret in the plist (the credential stays in ~/.config/barkbot/chat-host.json, read by the host program), loaded by launchctl bootstrap gui/<uid> and bootout; it refuses while npm run host runs on the same enrollment unless --replace, and npm run host refuses while the agent runs. npm run test:host-agent (41 checks: a scratch HOME, a stand-in launchctl, plutil -lint on the plist) holds the commands, their idempotence and the refusal. Not covered: the agent has never run under the real launchd, and no Mac has been restarted with it (needs Node, Go, the owner's Barkpark login, and a login after boot: a LaunchAgent starts only once the user logs in); a restart in the middle of a reply.
